review.notes: Full re-review of the repaired head: r3's R02-R07, R10, R11 repaired, R08 partly, R01/R09 turned into a re-plan (R01 here). Gate OK; depcheck 0 problems; Suggested.lean elaborates with 10 sorry warnings; #check of all 16 declarations compared with the README (5 dropped binders harmless); one-tactic probe closes nothing. Seeded sample (BoundedSequenceTranslation, SequenceToeplitz, SaddleFlow, LCAWeyl, concrete Cuntz families) recomputed in the adversarial table; Williams locators (36 labels) and de la Harpe (Def 9, Cor 12, Thm 14, p.19) verified at their lines; Muhly-Williams, Sims-Williams, Takeishi and Delfin-Farsi-Packer fetched and checked; Cuntz uncertified, Bratteli-Robinson and Renault paywalled. Blocking: D1.Modules, D4.Harmonic and D5.Fields re-plan HilbertModules H2-H3 and VonNeumannAlgebras V11 / V4.0.Fields (which main's version consumed and which the suppliers still build and expect this roadmap to consume) with false 'comes later and consumes' claims about HM, VNA, MAF and NQS; D4.Harmonic's general Bochner route cites a Polish-only uniqueness theorem.
